", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u017-r0007", "tag": "p", "text": "“There you are a baffler, Leoncia, which was just what I was going to call you. Nevertheless, it is not fair ... to me. I tell you straight out the heart of me, and you understand. You do not tell me your heart. You flutter and baffle, and I do not understand.
